say:2:1041534301:1.text: The Winter Carnival is almost here, and I can't help but feel a sense of excitement bubbling up.
say:2:1041534301:1.source_cn: 隆冬节快到了，真怀念呀。

say:3:1041534302:1.text: Every time I see a Yuletide tree, I'm reminded of the Lucent Tree from the Dark Forest—ah, yes, the one from your dreams!
say:3:1041534302:1.source_cn: 每次看到雪灯树，我就会想起薄暮丛林的流荧树——当然，是...

say:4:1041534303:1.text: After all, the Yuletide tree was created by the people of the Dark Forest to honor the Lucent Tree.
say:4:1041534303:1.source_cn: 毕竟雪灯树一开始就是薄暮丛林的人们纪念流荧树才搞出来的装饰。

say:5:1041534304:1.text: No matter where you are on the continent, when you look up at the falling snowflakes...
say:5:1041534304:1.source_cn: 无论在大陆任何一个地方，只要抬起头看到飘落的雪花……

say:6:1041534305:1.text: And see those branches still green, glowing under the light, it's like a little piece of home. For anyone far away from home, it's as if the loneliness fades away.
say:6:1041534305:1.source_cn: 看到璀璨的灯光下依旧青翠的树枝，离乡的人就不会感到孤独。

say:7:1041534306:1.text: Yes, I've seen those same branches in the dreams of so many travelers, longing for home.
say:7:1041534306:1.source_cn: 是啊，我曾经在无数离乡的游子梦中看到过那熟悉的枝叶。

say:8:1041534307:1.text: But... why do I get the feeling that now it's actually the people waiting at home who feel more alone?
say:8:1041534307:1.source_cn: 不过，我怎么感到，现在反而是在家等待的亲人比较孤独呢？

say:9:1041534308:1.text: Hmph, that good-for-nothing Lorsan—who knows where he's off gallivanting this time? I don't even want to waste my thoughts on him!
say:9:1041534308:1.source_cn: 哼，洛桑那家伙，不知道又玩到哪去了，我才不会想他呢！
